title: Strict-local base-change is invertible on global homology for a chosen model
statement: Let f:X→S be quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], s:Spec Ω→S a geometric point over an algebraically closed field [def-weil-geometric-point], and A a henselian local ring with separably closed residue field [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Let eA:Spec A≅strictHenselizationScheme(s) [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and let sq₀ be a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with maps p₀:X₀→X and f₀:X₀→Spec A over f and eA.hom followed by strictHenselizationStructuralMap(s) [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. For every bounded-below derived abelian etale sheaf K [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories] and integer n, global sections on Spec A of Hⁿ of the derived base-change mate of sq₀ [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] are invertible. This does not assert invertibility of the sheaf morphism or of its stalks.

proof.text: Compose eA with Scheme.Spec.mapIso (smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso s).symm.op to obtain an isomorphism e from Spec A to strictLocalization s. The existing smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso_toBase equation gives e.hom followed by strictLocalizationToBase s equal to the original eA.hom followed by strictHenselizationStructuralMap s. The same square is therefore cartesian over the adopted structural map. Apply the fully proved adopted model-global-homology theorem. Transport the bottom morphism by equality before supplying the cartesian-square witness; proof irrelevance identifies its commutativity proof with sq₀.toCommSq. This gives exactly the original conclusion, without comparing different derived maps or repeating the injective and pasting constructions.

theorem smallModel_isIso_strictHenselization_baseChange_modelGlobalHomology
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [HenselianLocalRing A]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme s)
    {X₀ : Scheme.{u}} (p₀ : X₀ ⟶ X) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (sq₀ : IsPullback p₀ f₀ f (eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso ((Sheaf.Γ (Spec (.of A)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).map
        ((derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq₀.toCommSq).app K)))
